primary: From the identical installed transfer parent, train a K1 dense full decoder on the identical 256 three-hop trace examples and 32 updates. Compare its fresh-map complete-trajectory accuracy to the previous K3 trained fork. Compare that K3-trained fork at K1 on identical requests for inference-depth attribution. Include untouched Base K1 as a deployment reference.
metric: verified three-state completed trace on 96 fresh disjoint maps, all arms same prompt and greedy termination; paired map bootstrap and all discordances
gate: K3-trained K3 exceeds both dense-trained K1 and its own K1 by >=5 percentage points; report metrics separately. No claim of equal total compute or multi-seed superiority.
